description: This file defines the class RetrieveConnectionResponse, which models the response to a RetrieveConnection command in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity framework. It handles JSON parsing and contains methods for creating instances from JSON data, as well as getters for response data.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionResponse
classes.description: Represents the JSON response received after a RetrieveConnection command, encapsulating the connection details and facilitating JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RetrieveConnectionResponse from a JsonObject and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new instance from a JSON string or JsonObject representation.

methods.name: getJsonObject
methods.description: Returns the underlying JsonObject representing the connection.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the ConnectionId from the JsonObject.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided entity JsonValue.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the connection within the specified schema version.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.
